notes.title: 🚀 Cosmic Run Demo Launches September 29!
notes.notes:
[p]Take control of the Zogark family, fugitives fighting for freedom in a galaxy ruled by the Ministry of Prosperity. With your ship, your crew, and your wits, you'll face overwhelming odds in short, intense sessions packed with action, choice, and chaos.
